assumptions.invalid_totals: raw retained; rate unavailable; no clipping
assumptions.standardization: four fixed SOC majors 11/13/15/17 at .25 each; no missing-cell renormalization
assumptions.target: original 69-cell technology-screened candidate parent frame; neither all jobs nor causal comparison
assumptions.unknowns: main known-reference-domain ratio; separate nonnegative HT unknown/membership envelopes, no MAR imputation
assumptions.unsupported_old: explicit zero auxiliary yields HT reference mass; raw old missing retained and no comparator/error-rate claim
assumptions.variance: stratified SRSWOR conditional on treating independent salted MD5 orderings as exchangeable draws; all sample rows and 207 cells enter residual variance

interpretation_guide: Compare the old candidate proxy and corrected operational-reference measure only where an old comparator is available.
The main point refers to a reference-known domain. The separate HT envelope concerns unresolved membership/outcomes in the full target.
For a proportion or GenAI-minus-software contrast, use the approximate design interval only under the stated exchangeable-hash sampling assumption.
Do not interpret the unknown envelope as a confidence interval, or the interval as accounting for semantic reference error.
These descriptive comparisons do not identify causal effects, cover all US advertisements, or establish semantic truth.

methods_qa.hash_assumption: Independent salted MD5 orderings are treated as exchangeable SRS draws; this is an explicit design approximation.
methods_qa.invalid_totals: Raw corrected totals retained; unavailable rate when denominator is nonpositive or totals outside valid range. No clipping.
methods_qa.joint_correction: Old proxy census plus dedicated design-weighted reference-minus-proxy residual for both numerator and denominator.
methods_qa.main_scope: Operational reference-known domain, including known technology membership, known entry eligibility when applicable, and known outcome. Unknown reference labels remain unmodified.
methods_qa.normal_interval: Point plus or minus 1.959963984540054 design standard errors; approximate, unbounded normal design interval, conditional on stated sampling assumptions.
methods_qa.standardization: Fixed .25 on each SOC major11,13,15,17; any unavailable required major leaves standardized point unavailable.
methods_qa.unknowns: Full-target nonnegative HT reference-mass envelopes are separate sensitivity summaries; they are not confidence intervals or missing-at-random imputations.
methods_qa.unsupported_old: Explicit zero auxiliary; no old comparator. It is not an observed old negative.
methods_qa.variance: Delta-method ratio residual with all sampled ads in all original arm cells; shared-sample covariance retained in contrasts and equal-major standardization.
